connector.name: VibeVO
connector.registryDescription: Use VibeVO API tools for campaigns, analytics, posts, creators, wallets, and factories.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.vibevo, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VIBEVO_API_KEY
env.description: VibeVO Public API key (vibevo_live_...). Mint it in the VibeVO cabinet with the scopes the agent needs.

env.name: VIBEVO_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the VibeVO API. Optional; defaults to https://api.vibevo.io.
